verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI video platform, but the evidence describes only HeyGen-hosted offerings: a cloud API, a hosted MCP server, and vendor-run dedicated GPUs. Nothing documents a deployable, self-hostable version of the core product. Enterprise options such as zero data retention and dedicated GPUs are adjacent controls, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
